title: Ian Cunningham on diversity in hiring: "There's still work to be done"

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ian Cunningham on diversity in hiring: "There's still work to be done"
sources.description: The NFL is struggling to balance the P.R. and legal realities of diversity in key positions with a potential political assault from those who regard the three-letter "DEI' acronym as a four-letter word.
